layout.spacing: Dense and compact. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards. gap-4 for grids.
layout.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0, rounded-md (max 8px border-radius). Avoid soft UI/shadows. Go for crisp, technical borders.

components.navigation: Sidebar or top navigation utilizing solid white background and 1px bottom/right border.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift and shadow-md.
components.chat_bubbles: Incoming: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900. Outgoing: bg-slate-900 text-white.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs with square-ish corners (rounded-md), focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900.
components.tables: Zebra striping optional, strictly left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers.

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts (e.g., bg-slate-50 to bg-slate-100) and border darkening. Buttons get slight scale-down or shadow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially badges, meet WCAG AA contrast against their backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, chat items) MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-item-nuevo').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 3-column layout: Conversation List (left), Active Chat (center), Detail/Agent Panel (right).
Implement states (nuevo, por_atender, en_atencion, esperando_cliente, resuelto, cerrado) strictly using the color definitions from the badges section.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do NOT use Inter.
Keep the UI 'cardless' or use very flat cards with sharp 1px borders (rounded-md, max 8px). Do NOT use heavy shadows.
Highlight unread messages clearly (e.g., bolder font, blue unread dot, background highlight).
Ensure timestamps are legible (e.g., 12:45 PM, Today).
Create a clean, sober, and business-oriented interface prioritizing speed and readability.
Provide specific data-testids for all major actionable elements.
Use standard .js and .jsx extensions for all files, avoiding .tsx.
All main components should follow Shadcn UI structure but custom tailored to matching the Swiss layout theme.
